xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3925: /api/parked and /api/merge-train/auto-merge take 10s+ on the live server

plan.title: /api/parked and /api/merge-train/auto-merge take 10s+ on the live server
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

metadata.sizeJustification: Seven items across lib derivation, the issue service, three routes, and docs (~13 files, 4 subsystems). The routes are independent slices over one new cache door; splitting the door from its consumers into sibling issues would ship an unused module.

narratives.Problem: After the cut, three dashboard routes derive issue state at request time by walking the whole issue universe. Measured live on 2026-09-19 (load avg 17): GET /api/parked 184s cold / 78s warm, GET /api/merge-train/auto-merge 12.9s / 21.8s, GET /api/agents 15.1s / 11.7s. The cost sits inside the batch door loadIssueStatesForProject (src/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.ts:662): for every issue without a row in the 200-PR forge listing — nearly all 975 PAN issues — it runs three sequential git execs (readBranchWithGit, line 388) and re-reads the specs directory and parked.md per issue. /api/merge-train/auto-merge additionally runs a serial gh pr list per registered project (13 projects, 0.7s each). /api/agents calls the single-issue door once per stopped agent across 846 registered agent states. IssueDataService already keeps a derivedStatesCache (issue-data-service.ts:303) refreshed off the tracker poll, but the routes do not read it, and a pure cache read would be wrong: the cache only refreshes when a tracker poll reports CHANGED issues (PR-only transitions never refresh it) and it is empty until the first refresh after boot, which would leave the God View's once-per-boot /api/parked fetch empty.
narratives.Proposal: Four moves, detailed in .pan/drafts/PAN-3925.md. (1) Make the batch door cheap: one `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname) %(ahead-behind:origin/main)'` per project replaces three execs per issue (git 2.43 on the live box; 0.05s for 483 refs), and the specs directory and parked.md are read once per call. (2) Add a TTL read-through door owned by the issue service: `ensureDerivedStates(issueIds)` serves entries younger than 30s (DERIVED_STATE_TTL_MS = PR_CACHE_TTL_MS), recomputes the rest through the batch door grouped by project with single-flight per project, stores them, and emits changes through the existing onDerivedStatesChanged hook. The logic lives in a new module services/derived-state-cache.ts so issue-data-service.ts (allow-listed at 1742 lines) does not grow. (3) Re-point the three routes: /api/parked keeps its candidate universe and calls the door once; /api/merge-train/auto-merge takes candidates from the tracker cache instead of a per-project forge listing (zero forge reads at request time); /api/agents collects every registered agent's issue id, calls the door once, and looks up. (4) Correct the docs and module headers that state the old cost model.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not add a fixed-cadence background refresh of the derived-state cache (the read model's staleness on PR-only changes when no route reads happen is a separate issue).
- Do not fix or preserve listCandidateIssueIds running gh pr list inside GitLab projects; the function is deleted, GitLab auto-merge routing is a separate issue.
- Do not derive states for issues that have an open PR but no tracker row (untracked projects such as papers-please, orca); after D8 they have no auto-merge row and the toggle renders 'Not routed yet'.
- Do not touch the other ~20 per-request getDerivedIssueState callers (command-deck.ts, merge-ops.ts, metrics.ts, system-health-service.ts, ...); only the three routes the issue names.
- Do not change the parked orbit rules, the FR-6 derivation table, or the auto-merge policy rules.
- Do not change any response shape or any frontend file.
- Do not call pushSnapshot() from the route-driven ensure path; only the poll-driven refresh keeps it.

autoDecisions.summary: TTL read-through over the issue service's derived-state cache, not a pure cache read.
autoDecisions.rationale: A pure cache read is empty at boot (the God View fetches /api/parked once and refetches only on sweep.scan) and goes stale on PR-only changes because the cache only refreshes when a tracker poll reports changed issues. Read-through fixes both; a miss is bounded by the cheapened batch door.
A recompute inside the PR-listing TTL re-derives against the same cached forge answer, so a shorter TTL buys nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: The cache logic lives in a new module src/dashboard/server/services/derived-state-cache.ts with injected IO; IssueDataService delegates to it.
autoDecisions.rationale: issue-data-service.ts is pinned at 1742 lines in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt, and the TTL/single-flight logic needs offline tests with an injected clock.

autoDecisions.summary: Branch facts come from one git for-each-ref with %(ahead-behind:origin/main) per project; only local refs/heads/feature/* produce entries; the fallback for git < 2.41 (stderr matches 'unknown field name') is a plain for-each-ref plus per-branch rev-list that drops branches whose rev-list fails; any other failure (including `failed to find 'origin/main'`) means no branch facts for that project.
autoDecisions.rationale: git 2.43.0 on the live box; measured 0.05s for 483 refs. Today rev-list fails for remote-only branches, so local-only keeps parity. /home/eltmon/Projects/myn is not a git repo, and readBranchWithGit already returns null there.

autoDecisions.summary: Seam precedence in the batch door: readBranches wins; else a caller-supplied readBranch keeps the per-issue path; else the git lister.
autoDecisions.rationale: derived-issue-state-server-facts.test.ts and tests/unit/dashboard/routes/resources-reclaim.test.ts inject readBranch and must keep working unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: /api/merge-train/auto-merge candidates are every issue in getSharedIssueService().getIssues(), not a per-project forge listing.
autoDecisions.rationale: In-flight states are only derived for open tracked issues, so tracked projects lose nothing and the route issues zero forge reads at request time. The only loss is an open PR in an untracked project, which AutoMergeToggle already renders as 'Not routed yet' for a missing row.

autoDecisions.summary: /api/agents keeps its keepStoppedAgentVisible rule unchanged and reads it from the batch result.
autoDecisions.rationale: The batch door sets apiError: false where the single-issue door reads pane text, but keepStoppedAgentVisible uses only state and pr, so the answer is identical.

autoDecisions.summary: ensureDerivedStates emits onDerivedStatesChanged but never calls pushSnapshot(); the poll-driven refresh keeps pushSnapshot on change.
autoDecisions.rationale: The read model turns onDerivedStatesChanged into issue_state.changed events; a full issues snapshot push on every route read is unnecessary traffic.

autoDecisions.summary: One issue with seven items rather than sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: Four subsystems and ~13 files, under the finalize size lint; the three route slices are independent consumers of one new door and would ship an unused module if split.

narrative.Action: PRD W1. In src/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.ts add `export type FeatureBranchMap = ReadonlyMap<string, DerivedBranchState>`, `export async function listFeatureBranchesWithGit(projectPath)` (one execFileAsync('git', ['for-each-ref', "--format=%(refname) %(objectname) %(ahead-behind:origin/main)", 'refs/heads/feature/', 'refs/remotes/origin/feature/'], { cwd, timeout: 15_000, maxBuffer: 16 MiB })), the pure `export function parseFeatureBranchRefs(stdout): FeatureBranchMap` (local refs/heads/feature/x rows become entries { name: 'feature/x', aheadOfMain: parseInt(ahead) || 0, pushed: remoteSha === localSha }; refs/remotes/origin/feature/x rows only supply remoteSha; remote-only branches produce no entry), and `listFeatureBranchesWithoutAheadBehind(projectPath)` (plain --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' then one `rev-list --count origin/main..<name>` per LOCAL branch) used only when the first exec's stderr matches /unknown field name/ (git 2.43 prints `fatal: unknown field name: <atom>` for an unsupported atom; a missing base prints `fatal: failed to find 'origin/main'` and must NOT take the fallback). In the fallback a branch whose rev-list fails is dropped from the map, never emitted with aheadOfMain 0. Any other exec failure returns an empty Map. Extend the batch door's deps type to `BatchLoaderDeps extends IssueStateLoaderDeps { issues?; readBranches?: (projectPath) => Promise<FeatureBranchMap> }` and replace the per-issue `await (deps.readBranch ?? readBranchWithGit)(...)` at line ~694 with: branches = deps.readBranches ? await deps.readBranches(projectPath) : deps.readBranch ? null : await listFeatureBranchesWithGit(projectPath); per PR-less issue branch = branches ? branches.get(featureBranchFor(issueId)) ?? null : await deps.readBranch!(projectPath, featureBranchFor(issueId)). readBranchWithGit stays for loadIssueStateFacts (line 578). No execSync anywhere.

metadata.acJustification: Six criteria: the cache door has six independently observable behaviors (TTL, single-flight, change emission, refresh/skip/rejection, service delegation, dedupe+parallel).

narrative.Action: PRD W3. Create src/dashboard/server/services/derived-state-cache.ts exporting `DERIVED_STATE_TTL_MS = PR_CACHE_TTL_MS`, `DerivedStateCacheDeps { now?; ttlMs?; resolveProject; trackerIssue; panes; loadStates; onChanged? }`, and `class DerivedStateCache` with get(issueId), list(), ensure(issueIds): Promise<Map<string, DerivedIssueState>>, refresh(issueIds): Promise<readonly DerivedIssueState[]>. Entries are { state, computedAt }. ensure: upper-case ids and collapse them to a Set (callers pass duplicates); fresh = now() - computedAt < ttlMs; group stale ids by resolveProject(id).projectPath (ids with no project are skipped); compute stale projects in parallel with Promise.all, single-flight per project; if the project has an in-flight promise await it then re-partition and batch only the still-stale ids; otherwise start computeProject(projectPath, ids), store the promise in inFlight, delete it in finally. computeProject: issues = Object.fromEntries(ids.map(id => [id, trackerIssue(id)])); states = await loadStates(projectPath, ids, { issues, panes: await panes() }); store each with computedAt now(); collect states whose JSON.stringify differs from the previous entry (or had none) and call onChanged(changed) once when non-empty; a thrown loadStates keeps previous entries and resolves. Return a Map of every requested id that has an entry. refresh = ensure with ttl treated as 0, returning the changed list. In issue-data-service.ts replace `derivedStatesCache: Record<...>` with a `DerivedStateCache` instance wired to resolveProjectFromIssueSync, this.getTrackerIssue, getBackendPanes, the LIB loadIssueStatesForProject, and onChanged → this._onDerivedStatesChanged; refreshDerivedStates becomes `const changed = await this.derivedStates.refresh(issueIds); if (changed.length > 0 && this.started) this.pushSnapshot();`; add public `ensureDerivedStates(issueIds)` delegating to ensure (no pushSnapshot); getDerivedState/listDerivedStates delegate. Remove imports the move made unused. If issue-data-service.ts ends above 1742 lines update scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt line 49 to `<lines> src/dashboard/server/services/issue-data-service.ts # PAN-3925` in the same commit. In the server adapter services/derived-issue-state.ts add `export async function ensureDerivedStates(issueIds) { return getSharedIssueService().ensureDerivedStates(issueIds); }` and one header sentence describing it as the 30s TTL read-through routes use. Tests inject now and never wait on real timers.
